items.author: Maureen Okonkwo, Senior BI & Data Analyst, Nov 6
items.summary: "The Receipt," a dark-themed Tableau dashboard that checks an AI analyst's numbers against the truth: 55 of 55 right when a metric is defined, 13 of 43 when the AI guesses, with correction emails. 2 reactions, 1 comment.
